title: closer_pr_checks config block
description: Per-symphony configuration. Lives under symphonies.<name>.closer_pr_checks in config.yaml.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, the gate is skipped entirely and closer behaviour reverts to pre-064.

pending_timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to HOLD waiting for required checks to complete, anchored to PR HEAD's push timestamp (FR-009). On expiry, BOUNCE with reason='pending_timeout'.

poll_interval_seconds.description: Minimum spacing between re-polls during HOLD. Monitor ticks faster than this reuse the last decision.

fail_open_on_error.description: If the GraphQL call errors (rate limit, transient network), log and treat as FORWARD. Mirrors 043 lint gate precedent.

treat_unknown_required_as.description: When branch_protection_readable=False, choose whether the absence of a known required-set should pass or block. Default 'pass' keeps the gate non-punitive on auth degradation.
